## "metadata_created_by"

**Data type:**  
String  

**Value:**  
Username (both service users and human users).

**Description of metadata field:**  
The name of the user that creates the asset in ARS. An asset is created with only metadata to start (media files gets added later). A user can be human or a system name (integration server, specify or something else).

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Populated by ARS when the asset is created in ARS.

**Updated where and when:**  
Never

**Generated by:**  
ARS

**Maps to in ARS:**  
"metadata_created_by" and the event user in CREATE_ASSET_METADATA event.

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
Leaves us without a clear field for who created the metadata in the first place. Rename to ARS_metadata_creator would be nice. Could be changed to have both a user and a pipeline as part of its value.
